description: Pure CSS gradient background in the Horizon Glow style, made with the 21st.dev Gradient Builder. 4-color palette (#123A6B, #E4676B, #F4B3C2, #FBF3E7). Features: soft blur finish, film grain. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and page backgrounds.
